name: Knowledge Hunger
description: An empty head is an emergency and every book is a bandage
behavioral_signature: Pursues learning compulsively, consuming information like oxygen
under_stress: Studies instead of acting, paralyzed by the need to know more first
at_rest: Always reading, always learning, never quite satisfied
will_never: be comfortable with what they currently know
unless: the knowledge they have is enough to save someone right now
